turns.user_text: Name one term someone reading about fully remote versus four days in the office would need to know, and define it. Answer in four or five sentences.
turns.model_text: One term someone reading about fully remote versus four days in the office would need to know is "presenteeism." Presenteeism refers to the phenomenon where employees are physically present at work, but are not fully engaged or productive due to distractions, stress, or other factors. This can include activities such as checking personal emails or social media, chatting with colleagues, or engaging in non-work-related tasks. Presenteeism is often contrasted with absenteeism, which refers to employees who are not physically present at work due to illness, vacation, or other reasons. By understanding presenteeism, researchers and managers can better evaluate the impact of remote work on employee productivity and well-being.
